# Conformance parity fixtures

These fixtures are the input corpus for `scripts/compare-conformance.mjs`. Each case runs the pinned upstream CLI and the Archie CLI in a fresh temporary target. The harness compares exit status, stdout, stderr, generated file sets, and generated bytes. It runs each case twice and compares SHA-256 hashes for every generated artifact.

The matrix covers valid, violation, strict-gap, dependency, cycle, exception, baseline, replay, reconciliation, and onboarding behavior. The malformed and stale-state checks exercise fail-closed paths in addition to the required matrix.

Only `cases.json` is the fixture manifest. The harness creates its temporary targets from these small source files so absolute temporary roots never enter canonical artifacts.
